content:
This text introduces a new Guardian email newsletter called “Fighting Back” that will run until Trump’s inauguration.  
It says the newsletter will share ideas from well-known writers and experts about how people can defend civil rights and basic freedoms during a Trump presidency.  
It also invites readers to subscribe if they haven’t already.  

Then it gives advice on what to do next: first, calm yourself down and take care of your mental state (breathe, walk, meditate, talk to people you trust).  
After you feel ready, it suggests you write a short personal “mission statement” that explains what issue you want to focus on and why.  
It asks you to think about the different places where decisions and influence happen—your town or city, your state, the federal government, businesses, and nonprofit/community groups.  
Finally, it encourages you to map out how each of these centers of power connects to the problem you want to work on, so you can plan where to take action.
